changelog: [Never Segment]: Added precise conditions for filler-laden false-start spans, chained repeated-adverb constructions, chained conditional/purpose constructions, trailing verbless fragments, and filler+appositive-dense sentences — targeting the exact boundary-placement failures the critic identified, without banning any connective ending outright.

[When to Segment]: Added two concrete permissive rules for safe, cost-free splits that were being missed — internal punctuation followed by a clause with an explicit NP referent, and sequential -고 time/action clauses that are each independently interpretable before the main verb.
